plain.summary: Each Job is assigned to one principal or none; while it is assigned, only its assignee acquires its lease or claims it. A principal assigns an unassigned instance to itself and unassigns itself; the config names no permission for anything else.

assign.useWhen: Use to assign an unassigned instance to yourself.
assign.success: Returns the assignee, when and by whom it was assigned.

errors.commonCorrection: None: the instance is already assigned to that principal.
None: only the assignee or an unassigned caller acts on its own assignment here.

unassign.useWhen: Use as the assignee to give the assignment up.

errors.commonCorrection: None: the instance is not assigned.
None: only the assignee or an unassigned caller acts on its own assignment here.

list.useWhen: where: { "Assignment.assignee": <subject> } lists the Job instances assigned to a principal, "Assignment.assignee": null the unassigned ones, and [null, <subject>] both.

permitted.summary: Each Job is assigned to one principal or none; while it is assigned, only its assignee acquires its lease or claims it. A principal assigns an unassigned instance to itself and unassigns itself; assigning another principal, reassigning and unassigning another need permission jobs.assign.

assign.useWhen: Use to assign an unassigned instance to yourself, or, with permission jobs.assign, any instance to another principal.
assign.success: Returns the assignee, when and by whom it was assigned.

errors.commonCorrection: None: the instance is already assigned to that principal.

unassign.useWhen: Use as the assignee to give the assignment up, or with permission jobs.assign to unassign another principal.

errors.commonCorrection: None: the instance is not assigned.

list.useWhen: where: { "Assignment.assignee": <subject> } lists the Job instances assigned to a principal, "Assignment.assignee": null the unassigned ones, and [null, <subject>] both.

acquire.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on an instance assigned to another principal.

errors.commonCorrection: Take work assigned to you or to no one, or have it unassigned first.
